title: clerodendrum obovatum
intro: Clerodendrum obovatum, commonly known as the West African lamp bush, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including the treatment of fever, malaria, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum obovatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
